bugs.title: No 'Continue as guest' option after failed sign-in
bugs.evidence: Wrong password shows 'Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.' (account-error) but there is no 'Continue as guest' control on the Account screen (getByText(/Continue as guest/i) count=0; grep of /app/mobile/app and /app/mobile/src finds no such string). Only the header Back arrow is there. Backend is fine: POST /api/v1/auth/login with a wrong password -> 401 {error:{...}}. JRN-46 expects a 'Continue as guest' tap. Everything else in this check passed: duplicate email -> 'Email already registered', short password -> 'Password must be at least 8 characters', register links local progress (UI 2000 coins == GET /me wallet.coins 2000).

action_items.detail: The auth matrix has no per-user resource route (no /users/{id}). The '403 for another user's resource' case was tested by submitting user A's run_token as user B, which is rejected with 400 run_invalid (token_mismatch). Add a 403 route if the spec requires one.
Google sign-in completion (JRN-47) and password-reset email delivery (JRN-49) were not tested headless (external).

Remote config states were tested by intercepting GET /api/v1/config in the browser, so the seeded remote_config doc was never changed. The offline queue was tested with an offline daily claim; offline runs were covered in the backend (POST /runs/offline returns leaderboard:false).
